title: Did Marvel Hide Characters in the Doomsday Trailer?
excerpt:
Fans have spotted unusual gaps in the final trailer's compositions.
The identities of any potentially hidden characters remain unconfirmed.
body_md:
Following the final Avengers: Doomsday trailer, Marvel fans have been examining individual shots for evidence that characters might have been digitally removed to preserve surprises. The speculation has not received official confirmation.

Among the scenes attracting attention are the Fantastic Four's meeting with Steve Rogers in the 1950s and their later appearance at Avengers Tower. Some viewers believe the composition leaves room for additional characters. A circular shot featuring the Avengers and X-Men also contains a conspicuous gap beside Sam Wilson.

Differences in visual effects between promotional clips, including displaced water during a meeting in Wakanda, have encouraged theories involving Namor and Talokan. These interpretations remain speculative.

Marvel has used promotional imagery that differs from its finished films before. A notable example is the group charge featuring Hulk in an Avengers: Infinity War trailer, which did not appear in that form in the theatrical cut. Such precedents help explain the scrutiny surrounding the new footage.

Fan theories have named Doctor Doom, Monica Rambeau, Deadpool and Wolverine as possible hidden participants. None of these specific suggestions has been officially confirmed. Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled for theatrical release on December 18, 2026.
